notes.title: Legacy of Kain™ Soul Reaver 1 & 2 Remastered | Patch 2
notes.content:
Patch 2 for Legacy of Kain™ Soul Reaver 1 & 2 Remastered is here!  

Below is a list of resolved issues and various updates. 

Full Changelist: 


Bonus Materials

 Added "The Dead Shall Rise” Kickstarter Backers list to the Credits section.
 Added the E3 1998 Demo to the Bonus Material section.
 Updated Nosgoth Lore with new locations and improved descriptions.
 Corrected Lore Reader locations for accuracy.
 Fixed a crash when switching to the "Corrupted" tab in the Lore menu while using Russian language settings.


Soul Reaver 

 Fixed a bug where Raziel could start floating after shifting into the Material Realm while in water and jumping immediately after.
 Improved visuals for enemy corpses in HD mode to better match the original version.
 Fixed a crash caused by saving behind geometry and attempting to reload.
 Ariel's scream during a vision sequence now plays only once, as intended.
 Fixed an issue with Dumah’s eyes not displaying correctly.
 Restored missing sound effects before and after visions, similar to the original PS1 version.
 Fixed a crash when using telekinesis in a specific area of the Human Citadel.
 Health capacity activity now correctly displays 100% completion.
 Fixed a crash when repeatedly viewing Chronoplast Visions.


Soul Reaver 2

 Fixed an issue where the Thrall NPC’s lower body would disappear in mirror light effects in HD mode.
 Adjusted timing so that subtitles during Raziel’s monologue no longer disappear too early.
 Fixed subtitles disappearing too early during a dialogue scene with Ariel.
 Improved distant texture rendering in underwater areas.
 Resolved an issue where textures displayed as "noise" instead of proper visuals in HD mode.


Localizations
 The "Hold to Skip" prompt now displays correctly in all languages.
 The "Exit to Launcher" text now displays correctly in all languages.
 Added Portuguese language support.


General
 Completed activity progress now properly carries over when starting a new game.
 Fixed an issue where stacked cubes could become stuck together when pushed.

notes.title: Buy a Game, Help Kids Beat Cancer
notes.content:
Aspyr is proud to announce that we, along with several other publishers, have joined forced with Team17 and GOSH -- Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity -- in their efforts to raise money to build a new Children's Care Center at the GOSH Hospital based in London.

As well as being one of the world's leading children's hospitals, the Great Ormond Street Hospital is the largest for children's heart surgery in Britain and one of the largest for heart transplants in the world. Fun fact: the hospital owns the copyright to Peter Pan. Who knew?

GOSH is running the Play it. Build it. Beat it. sale on Steam until 2/24 and Aspyr is donating ːgetreadyː 100% of its proceeds ːgetreadyː from Heads Up sales during this event to the hospital. The other publishers involved have also pledged to donate a portion of their proceeds to this organization. The sale is chock-full of cozy and co-op games, so buy some games to play with your buds. And make them buy games too. Hey, it's for the kids!

Some highlights from the Aspyr team:

 The Cult of the Lamb
 Overcooked series
 Cat Quest
 Little Kitty Big City
 The Past Within

notes.title: Legacy of Kain™ Soul Reaver 1 & 2 Remastered | Patch 1
notes.content:
Patch 1 for Legacy of Kain™ Soul Reaver 1 & 2 Remastered is here!  
Below is a list of resolved issues and various updates. 

Full Changelist:

 [SR1] The lighthouse’s beam is no longer missing (after being activated to obtain the Glyph).
 [SR1] An additional prompt has been added to the Underworld tutorial in SR1 for accessing the Glyph menu.
 [SR1] A toggle has been added to enable/disable the Day/Night cycle.
 [SR1] The Bell in the Silenced Cathedral is no longer cut off after being hit.
 [SR1] Fixed an occasional crash issue triggered when Raziel was killed by a flamethrower hunter.
 [SR1] Fixed an issue that caused the environment to de-spawn.
 [SR1] Fixed the Great Old One Achievement in SR1.
 [SR1] Fixed the backward hand in SR1 for the vampire hunter.
 [SR2] Fixed an issue where Raziel could occasionally become stuck in a room with a T-pose Moebius after skipping a cutscene.
 [SR2] Black cubes are no longer present on the Air Forge mummies.
 [SR2] When playing through the Oracle Caves, Cubes will no longer get stuck in each other. 
 [SR2] The display no longer squishes horizontally to fit the screen instead of cropping the sides when the aspect ratio is narrower than 16:9 on PC Steam and Steam Deck.
 [All] After disconnecting the controller, the game will automatically open the pause menu in either title.
 [All] A visual effect is now present when accessing and leaving the visions in the Chronoplast. 
 [All] The Split trophy / achievement no longer progresses when killing a Sorcerer Thrall.
 [All] Directional inputs can now be bound to the arrow keys.
 You can now press pause while watching the Bonus Materials movies.
 Certain tutorial prompts no longer display the incorrect button prompt in non-English languages.


Please note that the addition of the Kickstarter backer names will be implemented for the Day 60 patch, which is anticipated to be released in Late March 2025. More information soon!
